newsitem.title: USA: Fleet Financial provides $70 mln financing.
newsitem.headline: Fleet Financial provides $70 mln financing.

text.p: Fleet Financial Group Inc on Tuesday said its commercial real estate division provided $70 million in first mortgage financing to MKDG/Buck 123 LP.
The financing is to recapitalize an existing loan on the AMA building in Chicago, which serves as the headquarters of the American Medical Association.
The three-year first mortgage financing, which carries one two-year option, will be used to recapitalize a portion of an existing loan, Fleet said.
The remainder of the recapitalization is to be provided by MKDG's equity partners.
